editorial:
Ever wonder about the secrets hidden in old family stories or forgotten history? You get to dive deep into a real-life mystery with this film. It follows Commander José Moreno and his brave group of republican fighters during the Spanish Civil War in Galicia. The vibe is like a historical detective story. You follow the trail of these men who tried to escape by sea at the border of Galicia and Asturias but simply vanished into thin air. It feels personal and sad, making you care about these soldiers even though they lived a long time ago.

What really works here is how the director uses old records and interviews to piece together the puzzle. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit slow if you aren't into history. It is a great pick for anyone who likes true stories and unsolved mysteries. If you can, try to find the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a touching look at a lost generation that deserves to be remembered.
endingExplained: The movie ends by showing that there is no happy reunion. After searching through archives and talking to locals, it becomes clear that the group likely drowned or were captured and killed in secret. The final scenes show the empty coastline where they disappeared, leaving you with a heavy feeling. It wraps up by reminding you that while the men are gone, telling their story keeps their memory alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true history and mysteries.
